questions.question: Which cut should spec 003 take? Re-derived by Rule 2's witness shapes. BE-021 and BE-029 are single-call clauses (state, one call, its result), not function clauses as the dossier's candidate said: only their key predicate and the never-leak mapping are function-shaped. BE-020 and BE-033 are lifetime (a call sequence on one object). BE-030 to BE-032 are single-call clauses at the kernel-to-driver interface, which is Rule 2's second cut. Sizes are heading-to-heading line gaps from a Python regex `^#{2,3} ` over today's spec.

options.label: Kind + interface (Recommended)
options.description: Three files. 003 keeps the Backend interface's single-call contract: CAP-001–007, BE-001–019, BE-021–027, BE-029 (≈1,065 lines; BE-021 and BE-029 shrink in stage three's prune). New lifetime spec: BE-020, BE-028, BE-033 (≈240). New kernel spec: the Contract kernel intro, BE-030, BE-031, BE-032 (≈605). Strictly Rule 2: 003 stays large until stage three prunes it.

options.label: Also split BE-021, BE-029
options.description: Five files: the cut on the left, plus BE-021 (≈312) and BE-029 (≈316) each as their own single-call spec. 003 drops to ≈440 lines now. But inside one kind this cuts by subject, not by interface, which Rule 2 doesn't provide for, and 003, BE-021 and BE-029 cross-reference each other heavily.

options.label: Dossier candidate as written
options.description: Treat BE-021, BE-029 and BE-032 as function specs, as the dossier says, and BE-028 as an environment spec. I think that misreads the witnesses: most of their clauses need a state and a call, not only an input.

questions.question: Where does BE-028 (concurrent-use posture) go? A witness of a breach is an interleaving of calls on one instance. Only its reliance on native clients being thread-safe is environment. BK-455 cites BE-033 and BE-028 together, and BE-033's exit-owner row cites BE-028.

options.label: Lifetime spec (Recommended)
options.description: BE-028 moves with BE-020 and BE-033. Stage three moves its native-client reliance into that spec's Assumptions.

options.label: Stays in 003
options.description: No move now. Its kind is settled in stage three.
